traits.name: Site Bound
traits.text: The nemhaith is bound to a place or large stationary object and can't venture more than 500 feet from this focus.

traits.name: Bound Spirits
traits.text: (aura, divine, necromancy, negative); 10 feet, 4d6 (4d6) negative, DC 36 basic Fortitude.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.text: (divine, necromancy); Destroying the ritual object or place used in the nemhaith's creation destroys the nemhaith, freeing its bound spirits to move on to the afterlife.

traits.name: Drain Life
traits.text: (divine, necromancy); When the nemhaith damages a living creature with its spirit tendril Strike, the creature must succeed at a DC 36 Fortitude save or become drained 2. Further damage dealt by the nemhaith increases the condition value by 1 on a failed save, to a maximum of drained 4.

traits.name: Rage of Spirits
traits.text: ⬺ The nemhaith's bound spirits rage and smash everything in a 30-foot emanation. Creatures in this area take 4d6 (4d6) sonic damage and 4d6 (4d6) negative damage (DC 36 basic Fortitude save).

traits.name: Throw Spirits
traits.text: ⬻ The nemhaith directs its bound spirits as a group to move up to 1 mile away (they have a fly Speed of 60 feet). The nemhaith can see and hear through the thrown spirits, but it loses its aura and can't use its spirit dart ranged Strike or Rage of Spirits. The nemhaith regains these abilities when the spirits return to the nemhaith's space.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ spirit tendril +29 (agile, finesse, magical); Damage 3d10+14 (3d10+14) negative plus drain life

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ spirit dart +29 (agile, magical, range 100 feet); Damage 3d8+14 (3d8+14) negative plus drain life
